Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Owning an infrared sauna means constant maintenance and regular inspection of your parts and appliances. During this maintenance, you may find that you need replacement or new parts to keep your sauna business running smoothly.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we understand this need and this is why we make sure we have anything and everything that you may need for your infrared sauna.

We’re able to supply anything, be it from towels to audio players, from switches to power boards. All of our items are certified and went through strict inspection before we sell them to our customers. As you’re only aware, it’s very important to have quality and top-notch items for your infrared sauna so as you can ensure the safety of your premise as well as your customers’.

We take each of our item’s quality seriously, even something as small as a switch. We carry different types of switches that are compatible with any infrared sauna. We have switches for all your sauna appliances or electrical units. Our switches are made of high-grade materials and are safety certified to ensure maximum safety for your usage.

At InfraredSaunaParts we have a large facility to house all our goods so we’re sure you’re able to find what you need by browsing through our catalogues. We also offer a very competitive price for our infrared sauna parts so you can be sure that you’re going to get the best bargain in town.

We’re able to ship our products no matter where you are in the country and all you have to do is give us a call on the number below or fill up our online order form and one of our customer representatives will give you a call to help your further.

So why not take your time to browse through our catalogues so you’re able to see what we can offer you. Once you know you’ve made the right choice, give us a call and we’ll talk about how we can help your infrared sauna business.
